text: The Residence Time Driven Flame Spread (RTDFS) experiment will investigate steady and unsteady flame propagation over solid fuels in a microgravity environment. Theoretical modeling predicts that steady flame spread over solid fuels cannot be sustained, even in a high oxygen environment if the fuel exceeds a critical thickness. Flame spread rate over thin fuels in a quiescent microgravity environment decreases with fuel thickness not only because of increased thermal mass but also because the relative importance of radiative losses, as quantified by a non-dimensional radiation number, increases in direct proportion of fuel thickness.
title: Residence Time Driven Flame Spread (RTDFS)
